entries.zh: 詈语「禽狗人」：咒骂人如同禽兽狗畜（bestia）；骂人语、诅咒之词
entries.en: beast — term of malediction: to curse a man as a beast or dog
entries.notes: L 词头 genos 非标准西语词形（疑盲读讹误）；其释语 bestia/maldición 与 H 禽狗人、M quîm-cau-lãg 互证清晰，故取詈语义。

entries.en: to persecute; to press upon, pursue

entries.zh: 追捕多人；迫害；迫、伤、缚（迫傷繫：追迫致伤缠缚）
entries.en: to pursue, persecute many; to press upon, wound, bind (three senses listed)
entries.notes: R 栏录西语 mucho，疑系词头 persequir muchos 接写误入该栏而非官话对音；释义以 L 与 H/M（迫傷繫）为主。

entries.zh: 壮志：坚定不移之志；恒心（perseverar 坚持不懈；参见 constancia 条）
entries.en: to persevere; constancy, firmness of purpose; cf. constancia

entries.zh: 机敏，一点即通：点一点头便领会（见机即悟）
entries.en: perspicacious: he understands at the barest hint — point at it and he takes your meaning; quick-witted
entries.notes: L 栏 Perspical. en apun-fandole entiendele 疑为 Perspicaz. en apuntándole entiéndele（指向即悟）之讹形；H 末字盲读稅与全句义不合，疑为意之误。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（词头 Perguntar＝葡语「问」，v.g.＝例如，余栏空缺）
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕(headword reads Perguntar = Port. to ask; v.g. = for example; other columns empty)
entries.notes: 四栏仅 L 词头可辨且后文残损；M/R 空缺、H 栏误录拉丁字样 per puntar.，材料不足，仅按词头暂拟。

entries.zh: 贿赂，行贿（賄）；纳贿以求脱身（a librarse）
entries.en: to bribe, to give a bribe (dar soborno); to buy one's release, pay one's way out
entries.notes: H 賄、M iùbou、R dar soborno 三栏一致指行贿，而词头盲读 Persuadis（疑 Persuadir 讹形）义为劝，栏间有出入。

entries.zh: 劝动，打动（動）；短语后二字污损未详
entries.en: to persuade, to move someone (cf. 動 stir); latter part of the Chinese phrase smudged and undetermined
entries.notes: M 短语后二字 lan/hoi 带污损号（T99）且 H 未录对应汉字，短语全义未详；劝动义据 L persuadir 与 H 動互证。

entries.zh: 宛转：婉言善劝；好言开导（buena persuasión 善意劝导）
entries.en: to persuade; good persuasion (buena persuasión); to coax with tactful, winding words

entries.zh: 以软语劝说；婉言相劝（说）
entries.en: to persuade with soft words; to coax, talk someone round

entries.zh: 当人货：典押人口货物〔与词头义冲突，存疑〕
entries.en: to pawn people and goods (Chinese gloss); conflicts with headword persuadir (to persuade) — entry uncertain
entries.notes: H 當人货与 M tong-lang-huei 一致为典押义，与词头盲读 persuadir（劝）相左，疑词头或行次有误，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 干：关系到，与……相干；归属（pertenece 属于）
entries.en: it belongs (to); it concerns, has to do with

entries.zh: 干与：相干，与……有关；干预涉入
entries.en: to pertain to, concern; to have a hand in, meddle

entries.zh: 是我事：这事归我，属于我；是我分内之事
entries.en: it belongs to me; it is my business, my affair

entries.zh: 是尔个事：那事归你，是你的事（pertenecele 事属之）
entries.en: it belongs to him/her; e.g. it is your affair

entries.zh: 干求：为利而求请；因利害关涉（pertenece por interés）
entries.en: it concerns by reason of interest; to solicit, make suit for gain

entries.zh: 厝宅：房屋、住宅、宅第〔词句讹损，存疑〕
entries.en: house, dwelling (casa), homestead; pertains to the house (headword garbled)
entries.notes: L 句身大面积讹损（仅词尾 casa 可辨），M 双音节均带 T99 污损号；释义据 H 厝宅、M chiu-the 与 casa 互证暂定。
